Sandbox_PLS_TrackZombieKills_tooltip: Scores every zombie a player kills and shows a Zombie Kills board.
Sandbox_PLS_TrackPlayerKills_tooltip: Scores player-versus-player kills and shows a Player Kills board. Off by default.
Sandbox_PLS_AnnounceFirstPlace_tooltip: Tells the whole server in chat when a board's first place changes hands.
Sandbox_PLS_AnnounceCooldownMinutes_tool: Real minutes to wait between announcements on the same board, so two players trading the lead cannot flood chat. (0-120)
Sandbox_PLS_BoardSize_tooltip: How many ranks the server sends to each client. Players outside this still see their own standing. (3-50)
Sandbox_PLS_MinScoreToRank_tooltip: A player needs at least this much to appear on a board, so the list is not padded with everyone sitting on nothing. (1-1000)
Sandbox_PLS_CountAdminKills_tooltip: Off by default, so anyone on an admin, moderator, GM, overseer or observer account stays off the boards. Turn it on if your staff play normally, or if you host the server yourself and want your own kills counted.
